{{Top|leg}}
The '''trashur''' was the government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Essowyn]]. It was council of thirty-five [[Saurton]] citizens, chosen by the [[Council of Elders (Saurton)|Council of Elders]]. The government was empowered until the majority of its members had died, with vacated positions remaining unfilled.
